title_en: LOWE'S Profesyonel Under Eye Serum 30 ml
ingredients_inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Hyaluronic Acid, Panthenol, Allantoin, Niacinamide, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Vitis Vinifera Seed Extract, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Ceramide Np, Dunaliella Salina Extract, Glutathione, Caffeine, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Benzyl Alcohol, Dehydroacetic Acid, Parfum, Benzyl Salicylate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Terpineol, CI 77266.
directions: It should be applied to clean and dry skin. Apply a small amount of the eye contour serum to your dab fingertips. Gently and massage the serum around the eye area, especially under the eyes. For best results, use twice daily, in the morning and evening.
purpose_from_pack: Helps prevent the appearance of under-eye bags and dark circles around the eyes. Aims to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and to make the eye area look brighter.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes; in case of contact, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. Keep out of reach of children. Store in a cool, dry place.
label_company_on_pack: THE CEEL KOZMETİK İÇ VE DIŞ TİCARET A.Ş. (İstanbul, Ataşehir)
